guardrails_verified: P0.1 enrolment-status-only; no outcome/success claims; AI/automation cannot clear verification (human authorised override + reason only); BCI profile display disabled by default (LCR-002)
P0.2 institutional-email preferred; college-ID -> manual_review; conservative minor default (restricted until guardian consent); DPDP minimisation
P0.3 no raw tokens/OTPs/passwords stored or logged (non-reversible fingerprint); rate-limit lockout; re-auth for sensitive actions; every security event audited; biometric is capability boundary
E06 append-only versions; AI content labelled+cited; export-for-filing blocked until lawyer approves latest version (re-blocks after edits)
E07 review bound to immutable draft-version id; expiring/revocable no-PII links; stale-version protection; client approval != filing approval; consent-gated notify
screenshot_parity_note: No approved v3.2 design exists for Phase-0 auth or the Core module, so side-by-side visual-parity claims are intentionally NOT made. Screens reuse the locked design tokens and primitives; screenshots are functional evidence only.
